free.title: Free Sailing
free.note: A sail for its own sake: any ship, any upgrades, any look. Nothing here is kept, and your voyage is not touched.
help.windCopy: You can't sail into the red zone. You are fastest with the wind across the boat (green band).
help.tackCopy: To go upwind, zigzag about 50° off the wind, first on one side, then the other.
help.tradeCopy: Buy what a port makes, sell where it is wanted. Delivery orders pay extra. Open the map to compare prices.
help.pressCopy: When the sails control turns amber, then red, ease the sails or bear away, or cargo goes overboard.
help.touchLine: Drag to steer · two fingers turn the view · sail lever · tap a port
settings.title: Settings
settings.soundsNote: The sea, the wind, bells and sails
settings.turnCameraNote: Right stick, right drag or two fingers; off: north always up
settings.cameraReturnsNote: Turns back to north after a few seconds
settings.gentleMotionNote: The boat rises, pitches and shakes less
settings.cameraBobNote: The view rises and sinks with the sea
settings.weatherNote: Off: a steady breeze, no rain or storms
settings.stormsNote: Off: no storms cross the sea
settings.wakeStylesNote: Off: the plain wake, whatever the boat's look
settings.windZonesNote: Off: no trade belts, doldrums, stormy coasts or cold gales
settings.stormBeltNote: Off: no squalls march through the storm belt
settings.currentsNote: Off: still water, no current carries the boat
settings.seaDragNote: Off: she sails as fast in any sea as in flat water
settings.bergsNote: Off: no icebergs drift in the northern sea
settings.shipsNote: Off: no fishing boats, coasters or visitors sail the seas
traffic.label: {name}, out of {port}
settings.haze.ashNote: Off: clear sight in the volcano's ash
settings.haze.fogNote: Off: clear sight inside fog banks
settings.wavesNote: Wind and storm waves; off by default on Low and Ultra-low
settings.fx.occlusionNote: Ultra: soft shade in corners and under eaves
settings.fx.hazeNote: Ultra: the far sea fades into the sky
settings.fx.reflectionNote: The sky and the sun shine on the sea
level.title: New voyage
level.sub: How rough should the seas be?
level.captainTag: Read the wind or pay for it
level.saltTag: For sailors who read the sky
level.fair1: Steady trade wind that barely turns
level.fair2: Cargo stays aboard; the sails still warn you
level.fair3: Knocks cost half, repairs are cheap
level.fair5: Gales rarer, a storm every 15 min
level.captain2: Full sail in a gale throws cargo overboard
level.captain3: Reefs, shores and piers hurt the hull
level.captain5: A storm crosses about every 10 min
level.salt1: Gales more often, a storm every 7 min
level.salt2: A lurch throws 2 units overboard, not 1
level.salt3: Hard knocks, dearer repairs, thin margins
level.salt4: Towns need more trade to grow
level.note: The boat sails the same at every level: no-go zone, tacking and speeds never change. You can change the level later in Settings.
settings.difficultyNote: Prices, damage, cargo and storms. Sailing never changes.
settings.windNote: Steady: a trade wind that barely turns
toast.pressHintFair: Strong wind! Ease the sails: on harder levels cargo goes overboard
settings.resetBoatNote: Stuck? Back to start brings the boat back to port.
settings.confirmNewGame: Start a new voyage? Your gold, cargo and upgrades will be reset.
transfer.title: Move your voyage
transfer.scanThis: Scan me with the other device
transfer.how1: Open the game, then Menu → Move your voyage → Receive, and tap Scan.
transfer.how2: Or point its camera app at the code: it opens the game with your voyage.
transfer.copyNote: The code and the file hold the voyage as it is right now. Keep sailing on one device only: the two copies do not stay in step.
transfer.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR code on the other device.
transfer.noCamera: No camera here, or it was not allowed. Paste the code or open a save file instead.
transfer.pastePlaceholder: Paste the code or link here (FW2…)
transfer.unreadable: This is not a Fair Winds voyage, or it got cut or changed on the way. Copy it again.
transfer.newer: This voyage comes from a newer version of the game. Update this device first (reload the page).
transfer.otherMap: This voyage is for another sea map and cannot be sailed here.
transfer.otherVersion: This code was made by a different version of the game. Reload the game on both devices, then make a new code.
transfer.damaged: This voyage is damaged and cannot be loaded. Make a new code on the other device.
transfer.replaceTitle: Replace the voyage on this device?
transfer.replaceNote: The voyage on this device is lost unless you send it somewhere first.
transfer.saveFailed: This device could not store the voyage (private browsing or full storage).

toast.crashBoat: Rammed a moored boat! Hull {pct}%, repair in port
toast.crashIce: Ran into the ice! Hull {pct}%, repair in port
toast.tooShallow: Too shallow for her keel: only shallow ships cross here. Go round

wind.compassUpwind: Wind compass. Into the wind. Open sailing tips
wind.hint: Tap the compass for sailing tips
wind.helpCopy: Turn away from the wind to fill your sails. Zigzag to travel upwind.
wind.diagramDesc: Wind blows downward. Sail diagonally left, then diagonally right, to reach a destination above you.
wind.helpNote: Passing through the no-go zone during a tack is normal. The compass settles as soon as your sails can draw again.
chart.pauseHelp: Sailing and weather pause while the chart is open. The compass shows wind at your boat.
chart.bearingHelp: A bearing is not a safe route. Avoid land and tack into the wind.
chart.title: Sea chart
chart.instructions: Tap a port to set a course. Pick a good at the bottom to compare its prices at every port.
chart.mapLabel: North-up sea chart with islands, shallows, ports and your ship
chart.keyGood: Price of the good picked below; green is the best deal
chart.statusCleared: Course cleared. Sail wherever you like.
chart.statusPortSet: Course set for {name}. Close the chart when ready.
tutorial.offerCopy: Short hints, pinned to what you need to tap. Your real game: nothing is reset.
tutorial.offerNote: It never spends gold for you. Sailing pauses while this choice is open.
lesson.name: First voyage
lesson.aboard.title: Take Rook aboard
lesson.aboard.copy: Harbourmaster Rook, of {origin}. Thank the tides you heard my horn! My skiff’s done for, I’m afraid. Would you take me home, captain? The pier with the blue-and-white flag.
lesson.aboard.welcome.title: Welcome aboard
lesson.chart.title: Take Rook home
lesson.chart.copy: Rook wants to go home to {origin}. Open the map; sailing pauses while you plan.
lesson.chart.copy@touch: Rook wants to go home to {origin}. Tap Map to open the map; sailing pauses while you plan.
lesson.chart.copy@keys: Rook wants to go home to {origin}. Open the map (M); sailing pauses while you plan.
lesson.chart.copy@pad: Rook wants to go home to {origin}. Open the map with the {pad:view} button; sailing pauses while you plan.
lesson.choose-port.title: Choose a port
lesson.choose-port.copy: Pick a port on the map to set your course, then close the map.
lesson.choose-port.copy@touch: Tap a port to set your course, then close the map.
lesson.choose-port.copy@keys: Click a port to set your course, then close the map (Esc).
lesson.choose-port.copy@pad: Move the cross onto a port with the left stick, press {pad:a} to set your course, then {pad:b} to close the map.
lesson.home-port.title: Set a course for {origin}
lesson.home-port.copy: Pick {origin} on the map to set your course, then close the map.
lesson.home-port.copy@touch: Tap {origin} on the map to set your course, then close the map.
lesson.home-port.copy@keys: Click {origin} on the map to set your course, then close the map (Esc).
lesson.home-port.copy@pad: Move the cross onto {origin} with the left stick, press {pad:a} to set your course, then {pad:b} to close the map.
lesson.sails.title: Sails and steering
lesson.sails.copy: Raise the sails, then steer left or right. Lower them to slow down.
lesson.sails.copy@touch: Raise the sails with the lever, then drag left or right to steer. Lower them to slow down.
lesson.sails.copy@keys: Raise the sails with ↑, steer with ← →, and lower them with ↓ to slow down. Dragging with the mouse steers too.
lesson.sails.copy@pad: Raise the sails with {pad:rb}, then steer with the left stick or the D-pad. {pad:lb} lowers them to slow down; {pad:b} lowers them all.
lesson.sails.continue.title: I know these controls
lesson.wind.title: Let the wind help
lesson.wind.copy: Keep the bow out of the red zone. To go upwind, zigzag from one side of it to the other.
lesson.wind.continue.title: Continue
lesson.dock.title: Dock at {origin}
lesson.dock.copy: Follow the arrow to the pier with the blue-and-white flag. Lower sails early: below 1.5 kn near the pier, the crew docks you.
lesson.home.title: Bring Rook home to {origin}
lesson.home.copy: Follow the arrow to the pier with the blue-and-white flag. Lower sails early: below 1.5 kn near the pier, the crew docks you.
lesson.buy.title: Pick up a small cargo
lesson.buy.copy: {origin} makes {originMakes}, so it is cheap here. Buy one lot.
lesson.buy.continue.title: Use my existing cargo
lesson.choose-delivery.title: Find a buyer for {cargo}
lesson.choose-delivery.copy: Open the map and pick another port{cargoBuyer}.
lesson.deliver.title: Carry {cargo} to {delivery}
lesson.deliver.copy: Sail there, tacking if needed, and slow down at the pier to dock.
lesson.sell.title: Make your first delivery
lesson.sell.copy: Sell {cargo} here, or use Sell all.
lesson.sell.copy@touch: Sell {cargo} here, or tap Sell all.
lesson.sell.copy@keys: Sell {cargo} here, or click Sell all.
lesson.sell.copy@pad: Sell {cargo} here, or press {pad:x} to sell all.
lesson.done.title: First delivery complete!
lesson.done.copy: Explore, compare prices and save for upgrades. Sailing lessons are in the menu anytime.
lessons.name: Sailing lessons
lessons.sails.title: Hoist and lower sails
lessons.sails.copy: “Let’s see your hands on the sheets, captain. Sails up, then down again.”
lessons.no-go.title: Find the no-go zone
lessons.no-go.copy: “Point her nose straight into the wind. Feel her stop? That’s the no-go zone: no sail will carry you there.”
lessons.tack.title: Tack up to buoy A
lessons.tack.copy: “Buoy A lies dead upwind. You can’t sail straight at it, so zigzag. Each turn across the wind is a tack.”
lessons.reach.title: Reach to buoy B
lessons.reach.copy: “Wind on your side now: a beam reach, her fastest point of sail. Watch the knots climb.”
lessons.home.title: Run home and dock
lessons.home.copy: “Lower sails early and slow right down; the crew takes her in.”
lessons.done.title: Sailing lessons
lessons.done.copy: “Neatly sailed, captain. The course is here whenever you want it.”
lesson.foghorn.title: A foghorn
lesson.foghorn.copy: Someone is sounding a foghorn. Steer for the brass mark on the compass, and keep the bow out of the red zone.
lesson.wreck.title: Someone on the reef
lesson.wreck.copy: A small boat is stuck on the reef and someone is waving. Lower the sails and come alongside slowly, under 2 kn, without touching the reef.
lesson.thanks.title: Help Rook ashore
lesson.thanks.copy: Saltmere, and my own quay! Another tide on that reef and I’d have been swimming for it, captain. You’ve my thanks, entered in the book. And a harbourmaster pays his debts, so hear me out.
lesson.thanks.continue.title: You’re welcome, Rook
lesson.island.title: An island of your own
lesson.island.copy: “You’ve a feel for the wind, captain. There’s an old island just west of Saltmere, Skerry; nobody has lived there since the winter. It’s yours if you can make something of it. Now, a first cargo…”
lesson.island.continue.title: Thank you, Rook
quest.rooks-thanks.name: Rook’s thanks
quest.rooks-thanks.home.title: Call at Saltmere
quest.rooks-thanks.home.copy: Call in at the harbour office next time you’re in Saltmere, captain. I’ve a proposal for you.
quest.rooks-thanks.skerry.title: Sail to Skerry
quest.rooks-thanks.skerry.copy: Now, about that debt, captain. There’s an old island just west of Saltmere, Skerry, empty since the winter. It’s yours if you can make something of it. Moor at its pier and see what’s there.
quest.rooks-thanks.skerry-stranger.title: Sail to Skerry
quest.rooks-thanks.skerry-stranger.copy: I hear you handle a boat well. There’s an old island just west of Saltmere, Skerry, empty since the winter. It’s yours if you can make something of it, captain. Go and have a look: moor at its pier and see what’s there.
quest.rooks-thanks.plots.title: Plots to build on
quest.rooks-thanks.plots.copy: Bare plots and a sound pier, captain. Help the people of the islands, Kit, Ines, Maren and Ada, and each will give you a plot, with a building of your choice for it.
quest.rooks-thanks.plots.continue.title: What are they for?
quest.rooks-thanks.done.title: An island of your own
quest.rooks-thanks.done.copy: Each building makes life at sea easier: cheaper repairs, room to keep cargo, a look at the wind ahead. Come back once you’ve helped someone, and choose.
quest.saltmere-shoals.name: Where the shoals went
quest.saltmere-shoals.gulls.title: Find the diving gulls
quest.saltmere-shoals.gulls.copy: My boats come home empty, captain. The fish went out past the East Reef. Rook went looking too, and found the reef. Watch for diving gulls, and keep off the rocks.
quest.saltmere-shoals.channel.title: Sail through the reef gap
quest.saltmere-shoals.channel.copy: Gulls don’t lie. The shoal’s out there, past the reef. There’s a gap at the north-west end. Take her through gate by gate and I’ll buoy the way. A tack or two, mind.
quest.saltmere-shoals.catch.title: Rush the catch to Port Calda in {par}
quest.saltmere-shoals.catch.copy: Full nets, the first since the winter! Six crates, fresh as the morning. Go on, while they’re still jumping.
quest.saltmere-shoals.done.title: The shoals are back
quest.saltmere-shoals.done.copy: Full boats again, captain, and buoys on the gap. There’s a plot on Skerry’s hill with my name on it: {spotA} or {spotB}. Your pick.
quest.saltmere-shoals.plot.copy: Came over with the morning tide to stake it. Up here, see the number? {spotA} or {spotB}. Go on, pick one.
quest.calda-slipway.name: The last keel
quest.calda-slipway.stone.title: Bring 8 stone to Port Calda
quest.calda-slipway.stone.copy: Forty years I built boats on that slipway, captain. One more, a pilot cutter, then I hang up my adze. But the winter cracked the ramp. Measure twice, cut once: first, eight stone.
quest.calda-slipway.mast.title: Fetch the Greyback Ridge mast
quest.calda-slipway.mast.copy: The ramp is sound. Now a mast. The only pine tall enough grows on Greyback Ridge, and there’s no harbour there. Come in slow, under two knots, and mind the rocks. A good spar fills a hold.
quest.calda-slipway.launch.title: Bring Rook here in {par}
quest.calda-slipway.launch.copy: She’s rigged and ready, captain. No launch without the harbourmaster: fetch Rook from Saltmere, and make it a smart passage. A new boat deserves a proud start.
quest.calda-slipway.done.title: Launched
quest.calda-slipway.done.copy: Down the ramp sweet as butter, and she floats true. Thank you, captain. The yard owes you a plot on Skerry: {spotA} or {spotB}. Measure twice.
quest.calda-slipway.plot.copy: Pegs in, line taut, plot marked. A builder starts with a good plot, captain: {spotA} or {spotB}?
quest.westholm-mill.name: The mill on the hill
quest.westholm-mill.sails.title: Bring timber to Westholm
quest.westholm-mill.sails.copy: Flour on my hands and no flour in the sacks, captain! The winter tore the sails off my mill, and I need eight timber for new frames. Can you bring it?
quest.westholm-mill.millstones.title: Fetch millstones from Stonehaven
quest.westholm-mill.millstones.copy: The frames are up and the sails are sewn, and now the old millstones are worn smooth! Ada at Stonehaven has cut me two new ones. They’re heavy, so a sloop carries one at a time.
quest.westholm-mill.bread.title: Rush bread to Saltmere in {par}
quest.westholm-mill.bread.copy: The mill is grinding and the first batch is out of the oven! Four baskets for Saltmere, and bread is best warm, captain, so don’t dawdle!
quest.westholm-mill.done.title: The harvest fair
quest.westholm-mill.done.copy: The mill has its sails again, and all of Westholm is at the harvest fair! Thank you, captain. And there’s a plot on Skerry from me: {spotA} or {spotB}!
quest.westholm-mill.plot.copy: I brought a loaf and a stake, and the stake’s in! That’s your plot, captain, the one with the number: {spotA} or {spotB}?
quest.standing-kit.name: Kit’s standing order
quest.standing-kit.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Saltmere
quest.standing-kit.ask-1.copy: Two of my boats want new thwarts, captain. Timber, if you've any going. Go on.
quest.standing-kit.ask-1.thanks: Thwarts in, boats out. Gulls are already circling. Thanks, captain.
quest.standing-kit.ask-2.title: Bring grain to Saltmere
quest.standing-kit.ask-2.copy: The crews eat like gulls when the fish run. Grain for the galley, captain?
quest.standing-kit.ask-2.thanks: Full bellies, full nets. Have a herring on me, captain.
quest.standing-kit.ask-3.title: Bring stone to Saltmere
quest.standing-kit.ask-3.copy: The old smokehouse wall is leaning. Stone, captain, before it lies down.
quest.standing-kit.ask-3.thanks: Wall's straight. Smoke's going up, not sideways. Thanks.
quest.standing-rook.name: Rook’s standing order
quest.standing-rook.ask-1.title: Bring stone to Saltmere
quest.standing-rook.ask-1.copy: The quay steps are worn, captain. Stone for new ones, entered as a harbour expense.
quest.standing-rook.ask-1.thanks: Steps relaid, expense entered. In good order, captain.
quest.standing-rook.ask-2.title: Bring timber to Saltmere
quest.standing-rook.ask-2.copy: Fresh timber for the mooring posts, captain. The old ones have seen better winters.
quest.standing-rook.ask-2.thanks: New posts, sound as the book. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-rook.ask-3.title: Bring grain to Saltmere
quest.standing-rook.ask-3.copy: The harbour office keeps a sack of grain for hard days. It's light, captain. Noted.
quest.standing-rook.ask-3.thanks: Sack full, shelf full, page balanced. Entered in the book.
quest.standing-ines.name: Ines’s standing order
quest.standing-ines.ask-1.title: Bring stone to Port Calda
quest.standing-ines.ask-1.copy: The slipway wants ballast stones for the next hull, captain. Measure twice, carry once.
quest.standing-ines.ask-1.thanks: Ballast in, and she sits right. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-ines.ask-2.title: Bring fish to Port Calda
quest.standing-ines.ask-2.copy: Apprentices work better fed, captain. Fish for the yard, if you please.
quest.standing-ines.ask-2.thanks: Fed and sawing straight. That's a yard, captain.
quest.standing-ines.ask-3.title: Bring grain to Port Calda
quest.standing-ines.ask-3.copy: Grain for the yard's bread, captain. A keel's built on breakfast.
quest.standing-ines.ask-3.thanks: Bread for the yard, and a crust for you. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-maren.name: Maren’s standing order
quest.standing-maren.ask-1.title: Bring stone to Westholm
quest.standing-maren.ask-1.copy: The oven floor's cracked, and the bread comes out lopsided, can you believe it? Stone, captain!
quest.standing-maren.ask-1.thanks: New floor and straight loaves! Take one, captain, it's still warm!
quest.standing-maren.ask-2.title: Bring fish to Westholm
quest.standing-maren.ask-2.copy: The harvest hands want fish with their bread, and I want harvest hands! Fish, captain?
quest.standing-maren.ask-2.thanks: Fish and bread and everybody happy! Thank you, captain!
quest.standing-maren.ask-3.title: Bring timber to Westholm
quest.standing-maren.ask-3.copy: A sail frame cracked in the wind, and the miller's in a hurry, as usual! Timber, captain?
quest.standing-maren.ask-3.thanks: Frame mended and the mill's turning! And a loaf for the road, captain!
quest.standing-ada.name: Ada’s standing order
quest.standing-ada.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Stonehaven
quest.standing-ada.ask-1.copy: New scaffold for the quarry face. Timber, captain.
quest.standing-ada.ask-2.title: Bring grain to Stonehaven
quest.standing-ada.ask-2.thanks: Fed. Back to the stone. Thanks, captain.
quest.standing-ada.ask-3.title: Bring fish to Stonehaven
quest.standing-ada.ask-3.copy: Fish for the quarry crew. They've earned it.
quest.standing-ada.ask-3.thanks: Good. They'll cut straighter. Thanks, captain.
quest.standing-ness.name: Ness’s standing order
quest.standing-ness.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Watchman Key
quest.standing-ness.ask-1.copy: The lamp room's shutters are… where was I? Rotten. Timber, captain.
quest.standing-ness.ask-1.thanks: Shutters on. They rattle less than I do. Thank you.
quest.standing-ness.ask-2.title: Bring grain to Watchman Key
quest.standing-ness.ask-2.copy: Did I tell you about the winter I ate only… never mind. Grain, captain, for the store.
quest.standing-ness.ask-2.thanks: The store's full. I'll tell you that winter some other day.
quest.standing-ness.ask-3.title: Bring fish to Watchman Key
quest.standing-ness.ask-3.copy: Fish, captain. A keeper keeps, but he also eats.
quest.standing-ness.ask-3.thanks: A fine supper. Tam would have burned it. Thank you.
quest.standing-ness.ask-4.title: Bring stone to Watchman Key
quest.standing-ness.ask-4.copy: The lamp tower's steps are older than me. Nearly. Stone, captain.
quest.standing-ness.ask-4.thanks: New steps. I'll climb them slowly anyway. Thank you.
quest.standing-juno.name: Juno’s standing order
quest.standing-juno.ask-1.title: Bring spice to Sunreach
quest.standing-juno.ask-1.copy: A pinch of patience, and a sack of spice. The new blend wants both, captain.
quest.standing-juno.ask-1.thanks: Let it steep, and taste. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-juno.ask-2.title: Bring spice to Sunreach
quest.standing-juno.ask-2.copy: Tam's spice, captain, from the hill on Palm Key. The festival blend needs a little more.
quest.standing-juno.ask-2.thanks: The festival smells of the hill. A cup for you, captain.
quest.standing-juno.ask-3.title: Bring spice to Sunreach
quest.standing-juno.ask-3.copy: An old recipe of mine wants twice the spice. One more sack, captain, and patience.
quest.standing-juno.ask-3.thanks: Twice the spice, half the kettle. Perfect. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-tam.name: Tam’s standing order
quest.standing-tam.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Palm Key
quest.standing-tam.ask-1.copy: Uncle Ness says a good hut has a good porch. Well, he says a lot. Timber, captain?
quest.standing-tam.ask-1.thanks: A porch! Uncle Ness will say he drew it first. Thank you, captain!
quest.standing-tam.ask-2.title: Bring timber to Palm Key
quest.standing-tam.ask-2.copy: The drying racks blew over. Only a bit! Timber for new ones, captain?
quest.standing-tam.ask-2.thanks: Racks up, spice drying. And I tied them down this time!
quest.standing-tam.ask-3.title: Bring timber to Palm Key
quest.standing-tam.ask-3.copy: I want a little jetty for the skiff. Uncle Ness says it's a good idea. I think. Timber?
quest.standing-tam.ask-3.thanks: A jetty of my own! I've drawn it on my wall already. Thank you!
quest.standing-bram.name: Bram’s standing order
quest.standing-bram.ask-1.title: Bring obsidian to Emberhold
quest.standing-bram.ask-1.copy: Good glass shows you the truth, and the truth is I'm low on obsidian. Captain?
quest.standing-bram.ask-1.thanks: Black glass by evening. Have a look at yourself, captain. Handsome.
quest.standing-bram.ask-2.title: Bring timber to Emberhold
quest.standing-bram.ask-2.copy: Fire first, glass after. Timber for the furnace, captain.
quest.standing-bram.ask-2.thanks: She's roaring. Thank you, captain. Glass before breakfast.
quest.standing-bram.ask-3.title: Bring obsidian to Emberhold
quest.standing-bram.ask-3.copy: A big mirror for Rimewick's jam house, so the light goes round. Obsidian, captain?
quest.standing-bram.ask-3.thanks: It'll catch every bit of their pale sun. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-oskar.name: Oskar’s standing order
quest.standing-oskar.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Cinder Isle
quest.standing-oskar.ask-1.copy: Fair wind, firm keel, full hold. My hold's empty of timber, captain. Bad order.
quest.standing-oskar.ask-1.thanks: Good order again. Ines would say it took long. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-oskar.ask-2.title: Bring timber to Cinder Isle
quest.standing-oskar.ask-2.copy: A boat shed on stone feet, captain. Warm ground, cold timber. I need the timber.
quest.standing-oskar.ask-2.thanks: Shed's up. Ines would say it leans. It doesn't. Thanks.
quest.standing-oskar.ask-3.title: Bring timber to Cinder Isle
quest.standing-oskar.ask-3.copy: Measure twice, cut once, my sister says. I'd like something to cut. Timber, captain?
quest.standing-oskar.ask-3.thanks: Cut once, and right. Don't tell Ines. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-sigrun.name: Sigrun’s standing order
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-1.title: Bring cloudberries to Rimewick
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-1.copy: Three winters I waited for berries. Now I want more. Cloudberries, captain.
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-1.thanks: Pot's bubbling. One winter's worth of jam, by my count. Thank you.
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-2.title: Bring cloudberries to Rimewick
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-2.copy: Nell's berries, captain. The jam house runs out before the winter does.
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-2.thanks: That'll last till the thaw. Probably. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-3.title: Bring cloudberries to Rimewick
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-3.copy: A jar for every house in Rimewick. That's a lot of jars. Berries, captain?
quest.standing-sigrun.ask-3.thanks: Every house, one jar. Here's yours, captain. Don't count it.
quest.standing-nell.name: Nell’s standing order
quest.standing-nell.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Snowberry Isle
quest.standing-nell.ask-1.copy: The station's mast wants a brace. Timber, captain. Don't tell Kit I asked.
quest.standing-nell.ask-1.thanks: Braced. It'll stand the wind. Kit wouldn't have managed.
quest.standing-nell.ask-2.title: Bring timber to Snowberry Isle
quest.standing-nell.ask-2.copy: Glasshouse frames, captain. The cold finds every gap.
quest.standing-nell.ask-2.thanks: Gaps closed. Berries warm. Thanks, captain.
quest.standing-nell.ask-3.title: Bring timber to Snowberry Isle
quest.standing-nell.ask-3.copy: Firewood for the long nights. Timber, captain. Six years I did without. Not again.
quest.standing-nell.ask-3.thanks: Stove's full. Tell Kit I'm warm. He'll worry less. Or more.
quest.standing-elias.name: Elias’s standing order
quest.standing-elias.ask-1.title: Bring amber to Fogwatch
quest.standing-elias.ask-1.copy: Listen. The bench is quiet again. A little amber, captain, when you pass.
quest.standing-elias.ask-1.thanks: Small things, carefully made. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-elias.ask-2.title: Bring amber to Fogwatch
quest.standing-elias.ask-2.copy: There's an insect in one of Pip's stones, older than the fog. I'd like more like it. Amber?
quest.standing-elias.ask-2.thanks: Look closely, captain. A tiny wing. Thank you.
quest.standing-elias.ask-3.title: Bring amber to Fogwatch
quest.standing-elias.ask-3.copy: Beads for the foghorn keeper's daughter. Amber, captain. Quietly.
quest.standing-elias.ask-3.thanks: She'll wear them out on the rocks. Thank you, captain.
quest.standing-pip.name: Pip’s standing order
quest.standing-pip.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Amber Strand
quest.standing-pip.ask-1.copy: The hut's door blew off and the sand blew in, can you believe it? Timber, captain!
quest.standing-pip.ask-1.thanks: New door and no sand! Well, less sand! Thank you, captain!
quest.standing-pip.ask-2.title: Bring timber to Amber Strand
quest.standing-pip.ask-2.copy: More racks for the amber, and more baskets, and more everything! Timber, captain?
quest.standing-pip.ask-2.thanks: Racks up and baskets out! And a bead for you, captain!
quest.standing-pip.ask-3.title: Bring timber to Amber Strand
quest.standing-pip.ask-3.copy: A bench by the hut so Maren can sit when she visits, and she will! Timber, captain?
quest.standing-pip.ask-3.thanks: A bench for Maren! I've written to her already! Thank you!
quest.stonehaven-light.name: A light on the Teeth
quest.stonehaven-light.scaffold.title: Bring timber to Stonehaven
quest.stonehaven-light.scaffold.copy: Three boats on the Teeth since the winter, captain. I’ll put a tower on Teeth Rock, at the reef’s far end. It’ll stand a hundred years. First, six timber for the scaffold.
quest.stonehaven-light.stone.title: Carry stone to Teeth Rock
quest.stonehaven-light.stone.copy: Scaffold’s up. Now three blocks to the landing on Teeth Rock. Come in slow, under two knots. After that, a lens: old Ness keeps one on Watchman Key.
quest.stonehaven-light.lens.title: Fetch the Watchman Key lens
quest.stonehaven-light.lens.copy: Ada’s tower? About time. I ground this lens the winter of… never mind. Long ago. Here. Keep it dry and take it out to the Teeth.
quest.stonehaven-light.done.title: The Teeth are lit
quest.stonehaven-light.done.copy: It’s lit. It’ll stand, captain, stone doesn’t argue. A plot by the water on Skerry is yours: {spotA} or {spotB}. Choose.
quest.stonehaven-light.plot.copy: Staked. Good ground, by the water. {spotA} or {spotB}, captain. Then I build.
quest.fair-winds.name: Fair winds
quest.fair-winds.home.title: Come home to Skerry
quest.fair-winds.home.copy: Word gets round, captain. Kit, Ines, Maren and Ada have something for you, and so do I. Sail home to Skerry. We’ll be waiting on the pier.
quest.fair-winds.done.title: A company of your own
quest.fair-winds.done.copy: Everyone came, captain. Kit brought fish, Maren brought bread, Ines raised a flagpole and Ada cut a name board. Entered in the book, in good order: the Fair Winds Trading Company.
quest.watchman-passage.name: The keeper’s passage
quest.watchman-passage.chart.title: Sail south to Sunreach
quest.watchman-passage.chart.copy: That lens put me in mind of the winter I… never mind. My old chart, captain. Through the Keeper's Passage in the Coral Line, then south to Sunreach.
quest.watchman-passage.done.title: Sunreach, as Ness drew it
quest.watchman-passage.done.copy: Sunreach, just as I drew it. Well, nearly. Say hello to Juno at the tea house for me. She brews a fine cup, when she has the makings.
quest.sunreach-tea.name: The idle tea house
quest.sunreach-tea.bread.title: Bring bread to Sunreach
quest.sunreach-tea.bread.copy: A pinch of patience, captain, and let it steep. That’s what I tell myself. No spice, no blend, and my pickers gone to sea. Eight of Maren’s bread would feed the few who stayed.
quest.sunreach-tea.garden.title: Look at Palm Key’s garden
quest.sunreach-tea.garden.copy: The spice came from Palm Key, wild on the hill. Nobody’s been in years. Sail by its west beach, slowly, and see. A shallow keel takes the Narrows; deep ones go round.
quest.sunreach-tea.racks.title: Bring planks to Sunreach
quest.sunreach-tea.racks.copy: Still growing, then. Good. Now the drying racks: ten planks, and the house is ready for the day the spice comes back.
quest.sunreach-tea.done.title: The tea house is ready
quest.sunreach-tea.done.copy: Racks mended, kettle on. Thank you, captain. Now someone must gather on Palm Key. Old Ness always said his great-nephew Tam wanted an island of his own.
quest.outpost-south.name: Palm Key
quest.outpost-south.supplies.title: Bring timber to Palm Key
quest.outpost-south.supplies.copy: Tam’s coming, bless him, and he’ll want a roof. Ten timber and six planks to the landing on Palm Key, captain. Come in slow, it’s shallow by the beach.
quest.outpost-south.settler.title: Bring Tam to Palm Key
quest.outpost-south.settler.copy: Uncle Ness says a good keeper packs light. Well, he says a lot. But it’s only the one bag! Palm Key, captain? I’ve had it drawn on my wall for years.
quest.outpost-south.done.title: Palm Key is founded
quest.outpost-south.done.copy: Came over in the skiff with our first basket! The flag’s up on Palm Key. Bring what we gather to Juno here, captain, and the tea house will do the rest. Rook will want that in the book.
quest.calda-letter.name: A letter from Emberhold
quest.calda-letter.chart.title: Sail west to Emberhold
quest.calda-letter.chart.copy: A letter from my brother Oskar, captain, the first in a year. He’s at Emberhold, out west where the hills smoke. Here’s his chart, through the Forge Gap in the black reef. I’d go myself, but the slipway won’t mind itself.
quest.calda-letter.done.title: Emberhold, under the smoke
quest.calda-letter.done.copy: Black sand and smoke, just as Oskar wrote? He says to ask for Bram Kettle at the glassworks on the quay. His furnace has gone cold, it seems.
quest.emberhold-glass.name: The cold furnace
quest.emberhold-glass.kiln.title: Bring cut stone to Emberhold
quest.emberhold-glass.kiln.copy: Good glass shows you the truth, captain, and the truth is my furnace is cold. The lining cracked. Good glass needs a good fire, and a good fire needs good stone: eight cut stone from Stonehaven.
quest.emberhold-glass.smoulder.title: Look round The Smoulder
quest.emberhold-glass.smoulder.copy: Relined, and tight as a bell. Now, my black glass came from the obsidian beds on the Smoulder, but the lava’s been busy. Sail round her and see what’s left. Keep off her rocks.
quest.emberhold-glass.furnace.title: Bring timber to Emberhold
quest.emberhold-glass.furnace.copy: Fresh rock over the old beds, then. Pity. Well, fire first, glass after. Twelve timber, captain, and we light her again.
quest.emberhold-glass.done.title: The furnace glows again
quest.emberhold-glass.done.copy: Look at that glow! Thank you, captain. Hear the Smoulder rumbling along? When it settles, there’ll be new ground out there, and Oskar Calder has waited years for ground of his own.
quest.outpost-west.name: Cinder Isle
quest.outpost-west.supplies.title: Bring planks to Cinder Isle
quest.outpost-west.supplies.copy: New ground, steaming where the sea was! Oskar won’t wait. The ground’s still warm, so he’ll build on stone feet. Ten planks and six timber to the landing on Cinder Isle, captain. Come in slow.
quest.outpost-west.settler.title: Bring Oskar to Cinder Isle
quest.outpost-west.settler.copy: Fair wind, firm keel, full hold. That’s the order, captain, and the hold’s full. Ines would say I’m late. Ines says that about everything. Cinder Isle, if you please.
quest.outpost-west.done.title: Cinder Isle is founded
quest.outpost-west.done.copy: Flag’s up, and the ground’s glittering with obsidian! Bring what we gather to Bram at Emberhold, captain, and the glassworks will do the rest. Rook will want that in the book.
quest.saltmere-letter.name: A letter for the north
quest.saltmere-letter.chart.title: Sail north to Rimewick
quest.saltmere-letter.chart.copy: A letter from my sister Nell, up north in Rimewick, captain. Six years without a word, and now she asks if the shoals came back. Through the Rime Gate, past the Floe Line. Take her my answer: they did, and I found them.
quest.saltmere-letter.done.title: Rimewick, at last
quest.saltmere-letter.done.copy: A Saltmere boat, this far north? Nell will be pleased, though she’d never say so. She’s out on the ice today. If you’re staying, captain, come and see me at the jam house. It’s cold, and it shouldn’t be.
quest.rimewick-jam.name: The cold jam house
quest.rimewick-jam.oil.title: Bring lamp oil to Rimewick
quest.rimewick-jam.oil.copy: Three winters I’ve waited for berries. One more won’t hurt. But the jam house is cold and the old beacon on Lead Rock is dark, and both want lamp oil. Eight casks, captain. Watchman Key has it.
quest.rimewick-jam.lead.title: Look at Lead Rock
quest.rimewick-jam.lead.copy: That’s the stove lit. Now go and look at the pack, slowly. The beacon rock still stands at the mouth of the lead, if the winters left it any stones. Keep off the ice, captain. It’s sat there eleven winters and won’t move for you.
quest.rimewick-jam.beacon.title: Rebuild the beacon on Lead Rock
quest.rimewick-jam.beacon.copy: Tumbled, then. Six cut stones from Stonehaven and we stack it again, with the lamp on top. Bring her in under two knots. That rock doesn’t move for anyone.
quest.rimewick-jam.done.title: The beacon is lit
quest.rimewick-jam.done.copy: Lit, and you can hear the pack cracking from here. Nell has wanted to go back to the old weather station for years, captain. Eleven winters, by my count. Now she can.
quest.outpost-north.name: Snowberry Isle
quest.outpost-north.supplies.title: Bring planks to Snowberry Isle
quest.outpost-north.supplies.copy: The lead’s open, so the station needs a roof and the glasshouse a footing. Eight planks and four cut stone to Snowberry Isle, captain. Slow in the cove: the shelf ice is still there.
quest.outpost-north.settler.title: Bring Nell to Snowberry Isle
quest.outpost-north.settler.copy: Kit wrote, did he? First letter in six years. He’ll say he found the shoals himself, I bet. One bag, captain, and my old notebook. The station has waited long enough.
quest.outpost-north.done.title: Snowberry Isle is founded
quest.outpost-north.done.copy: The flag’s up and the glasshouse is warm already. Bring what we gather to Sigrun at Rimewick, captain, and the jam house will do the rest. Rook will want that in the book.
quest.westholm-letter.name: A letter from Fogwatch
quest.westholm-letter.chart.title: Sail east to Fogwatch
quest.westholm-letter.chart.copy: A letter from my cousin Pip, captain, all the way from Fogwatch! Out east, past the Stepping Stones and through Gannet Sound. And the mill has its sails again, tell her that, and mind the fog!
quest.westholm-letter.done.title: Fogwatch, in the fog
quest.westholm-letter.done.copy: Grey and quiet, just as Pip wrote? She says to ask for Elias Morrow, the amber carver on the quay. His workshop has been shut a long while, and she’d like to know why!
quest.fogwatch-amber.name: The quiet workshop
quest.fogwatch-amber.fish.title: Bring smoked fish to Fogwatch
quest.fogwatch-amber.fish.copy: Listen. The fog has a sound, if you wait. These days it’s the only sound on the quay. Few boats go out in the fog now, so we eat what comes in. Eight smoked fish, captain, from Saltmere.
quest.fogwatch-amber.way.title: Out past the fog
quest.fogwatch-amber.way.copy: Thank you. My amber came from Amber Strand, south of here, beyond the Stormbreak. Out past the fog the weather comes in breaths. Wait for the quiet one, captain.
quest.fogwatch-amber.way.continue.title: Which way?
quest.fogwatch-amber.strand.title: Look at Amber Strand
quest.fogwatch-amber.strand.copy: Round the west end of the Stormbreak, or cross it in a lull. Then come in under three knots and look at the beach for me. Small things, captain. Tell me what you see.
quest.fogwatch-amber.light.title: Bring lamp oil to Fogwatch
quest.fogwatch-amber.light.copy: Amber in the tideline, then, and only gull prints beside it. Now a light: the foghorn tower is dark, and boats can’t find the Voe in the fog. Eight casks of lamp oil, captain, from Watchman Key.
quest.fogwatch-amber.done.title: The foghorn tower is lit
quest.fogwatch-amber.done.copy: The tower’s lit and my shutters are open. Thank you, captain. But a bench wants amber, and nobody gathers on the strand now. Pip Holt walks that beach every summer. Ask her.
quest.outpost-east.name: Amber Strand
quest.outpost-east.supplies.title: Bring timber to Amber Strand
quest.outpost-east.supplies.copy: Pip’s packing already, captain. The strand wants a hut out of the wind, and racks to dry what the sea brings. Eight timber and six planks to the landing on Amber Strand. Come in slow.
quest.outpost-east.settler.title: Bring Pip to Amber Strand
quest.outpost-east.settler.copy: Amber on the beach and nobody to pick it up, can you believe it? And Maren’s mill has its sails again, you say, and now it’s my turn! Two baskets and my boots, captain, and off we go!
quest.outpost-east.done.title: Amber Strand is founded
quest.outpost-east.done.copy: The flag’s up and the baskets are out already! Bring what we gather to Elias at Fogwatch, captain, and the workshop will do the rest. Rook will want that in the book.
quest.four-winds.name: Four winds
quest.four-winds.home.title: Sail home to Skerry
quest.four-winds.home.copy: Four seas, four outposts, four crafts, captain. That’s a full page in the book, and a full page wants a signature. Sail home to Skerry. I’ll be on the pier.
quest.four-winds.done.title: A full page
quest.four-winds.done.copy: Entered in the book, in good order: tea, mirrors, jam and amber, and a signpost on your pier pointing to all four. Fair winds from every quarter, captain.
quest.club-hint.name: The club at Abbey Head
quest.club-hint.visit.title: Sail to Abbey Head
quest.club-hint.visit.copy: Wren Tally’s put up a shed on Abbey Head, captain. She’ll race anyone. Mind the tea.
quest.club-hint.done.title: Welcome to the club
quest.club-hint.done.copy: Abbey Head, captain, and the best wind on the chart. Rook lent me the shed, and the kettle’s mine. Every course I know is on the board. Sail one, drink tea, sail another.

keeper.rook.before.1: Boats in, boats out, and the nets come home empty. It’s all in the book.
keeper.rook.before.2: Kit’s on the quay again, staring at the reef. Have a word, captain.
keeper.rook.running.1: Kit’s whistling. That’s new. Entered in the book.
keeper.rook.running.2: Mind the reef gap, captain. I know it better than I’d like.
keeper.rook.done.1: Fish on the quay and buoys on the gap. In good order.
keeper.rook.done.2: Saltmere’s busy again, captain. The book needs a new page.
keeper.rook.grew.1: New moorings on the quay. I’ve entered them already.
keeper.ines.before.1: Forty years on that slipway, and the winter cracked it. Mind the keel.
keeper.ines.before.2: A yard without a launch is a sad yard, captain.
keeper.ines.running.1: Measure twice, cut once. We’re getting there.
keeper.ines.running.2: A good spar fills a hold. And a good captain fills a yard.
keeper.ines.done.1: She’s sailing the islands now, my last keel. Fair wind to her.
keeper.ines.done.2: The yard’s quiet, but it’s a good quiet, captain.
keeper.ines.grew.1: More hulls on the hard. The yard likes company.
keeper.maren.before.1: No sails on the mill and no flour in the sacks, can you believe it?
keeper.maren.before.2: The winter took my sails and left me the hill, captain!
keeper.maren.running.1: Frames up and sails sewn, and now the stones! One thing, then another!
keeper.maren.running.2: Flour on my hands again, captain, and I’m not complaining!
keeper.maren.done.1: The mill’s turning and the oven’s warm, and there’s a loaf for you!
keeper.maren.done.2: Bread for Saltmere and bread for the quay, and bread for anyone!
keeper.maren.grew.1: More houses on the hill, and more mouths, and more bread!
keeper.ada.before.1: Three boats on the Teeth since the winter. Too many.
keeper.ada.before.2: Good stone here, captain. Nobody to carry it.
keeper.ada.running.1: The tower’s going up. Stone doesn’t argue.
keeper.ada.running.2: Slow at Teeth Rock, captain. The rock won’t move for you.
keeper.ada.done.1: Lit. It’ll stand a hundred years.
keeper.ada.done.2: No boats on the Teeth since. Good.
keeper.ness.before.1: Did I tell you about the winter of… never mind. Mind the reef.
keeper.ness.before.2: A keeper keeps, captain. I keep oil, mostly. And a lens.
keeper.ness.running.1: My lens on the Teeth, at last. Or is it the chart now? Both, yes.
keeper.ness.running.2: South, past the Coral Line. I drew it myself, you know. Long ago.
keeper.ness.done.1: Tam writes from Palm Key. Long letters. He gets that from me.
keeper.ness.done.2: The lamps are trimmed, captain. They usually are.
keeper.ness.grew.1: More houses on my rock. When did that happen?
keeper.juno.before.1: A pinch of patience, captain. The tea house is quiet these days.
keeper.juno.before.2: No spice, no blend. Just the kettle and me.
keeper.juno.running.1: The house is warming up, like a good pot. Let it steep.
keeper.juno.running.2: Palm Key’s garden, still growing. That’s the best news in years.
keeper.juno.done.1: Spice from Palm Key, and the blend’s as good as ever. Taste, captain.
keeper.juno.done.2: Every cup in the islands starts here now. Slowly.
keeper.juno.grew.1: More cups on the terrace. The town’s steeping nicely.
keeper.bram.before.1: Good glass shows you the truth. Today the truth is a cold furnace.
keeper.bram.before.2: Black sand, black smoke, and no black glass. Pity.
keeper.bram.running.1: Fire first, glass after. We’re halfway, captain.
keeper.bram.running.2: Hear the Smoulder? She’s thinking. So am I.
keeper.bram.done.1: Look in that mirror, captain. That’s a good captain.
keeper.bram.done.2: The furnace glows and Oskar sends obsidian. Glass after breakfast.
keeper.bram.grew.1: More windows in town, and every one of them mine.
keeper.sigrun.before.1: Eleven winters of ice in the lead. I’ve counted every one.
keeper.sigrun.before.2: A cold jam house is just a house, captain.
keeper.sigrun.running.1: Stove lit. That’s one winter’s worth of good news.
keeper.sigrun.running.2: Slowly by the pack, captain. It’s patient. So am I.
keeper.sigrun.done.1: Berries in the pot. Three winters I waited. Worth it.
keeper.sigrun.done.2: Nell’s station sends the weather. It’s mostly cold. She’s mostly right.
keeper.sigrun.grew.1: More chimneys smoking. That’s a warm winter, by Rimewick count.
keeper.elias.before.1: Listen. The fog has a sound, if you wait.
keeper.elias.before.2: My shutters have been closed a long while, captain.
keeper.elias.running.1: Small things first, captain. They’re the ones that matter.
keeper.elias.running.2: Out past the fog, the weather comes in breaths. Wait for the quiet one.
keeper.elias.done.1: Hear the foghorn? Boats find the Voe again.
keeper.elias.done.2: Amber from the strand, and the bench is warm. Thank you, quietly.
keeper.elias.grew.1: More voices on the quay. The fog sounds different now.
keeper.tam.done.1: Uncle Ness says a keeper packs light. I’ve unpacked everything!
keeper.tam.done.2: Spice on the hill and a flag on the pole. My own island, captain!
keeper.tam.grew.1: More huts! Uncle Ness won’t believe it. Well, he’ll say he knew.
keeper.oskar.done.1: Fair wind, firm keel, full hold. And warm ground underfoot.
keeper.oskar.done.2: Obsidian in the sand, captain. Bram gets every piece.
keeper.oskar.grew.1: Stone feet, sound roofs. Ines would say I’m late. I’m not.
keeper.nell.done.1: Station’s sending. Tell Kit it’s cold. He’ll pretend he knew.
keeper.nell.done.2: Glasshouse warm, berries red. Not bad for a rock in the ice.
keeper.nell.grew.1: More roofs on the isle. Still cold. Less lonely.
keeper.pip.done.1: Amber in my baskets and sand in my boots, and I love it!
keeper.pip.done.2: Elias gets every bead’s worth, and Maren gets my letters!
keeper.pip.grew.1: More huts on the strand, and more baskets, and more amber!

quest.race-gap.name: Round the Gap
quest.race-gap.race.title: Race round the gap buoys
quest.race-gap.race.copy: Wren Tally, captain, and that’s Kestrel. A visiting skipper, and I race anyone. Let’s see how you sail. Round Kit’s buoys and back, best time wins.
quest.race-gap.race.start: Entered in the book: two boats, one course. On the horn, captain.
quest.race-calda.name: The Calda Dash
quest.race-calda.race.title: Race Wren to Port Calda
quest.race-calda.race.copy: Through the reef gap and on to Port Calda, captain. Ines has promised to watch for the first sail. Mind the marks. I'll be busy passing you.
quest.race-calda.race.start: Two sails at the line. In good order. On the horn.
quest.race-greyback.name: Round Greyback
quest.race-greyback.race.title: Race round Greyback Ridge
quest.race-greyback.race.copy: Round Greyback Ridge and home to Saltmere, captain. A long beat and a fast run. That's where races are won, or so I tell people.
quest.race-greyback.race.start: Measure twice, sail once. Off you go on the horn, captain.
quest.race-narrows.name: The Narrows Run
quest.race-narrows.race.title: Race the Palm Key Narrows
quest.race-narrows.race.copy: Juno says the Narrows suit a shallow keel. I say they suit the bold. Round Palm Key and back to Sunreach, captain. The long way's open if you're deep.
quest.race-narrows.race.start: A pinch of patience at the line, captain, then none at all. On the horn.
quest.race-smoulder.name: Round the Smoulder
quest.race-smoulder.race.title: Race round The Smoulder
quest.race-smoulder.race.copy: One lap of the Smoulder from Emberhold, captain. Warm water, black rocks, and Bram's mirrors flashing at the finish. Keep off her rocks.
quest.race-smoulder.race.start: Good glass shows you the truth, captain. So does a finish line. On the horn.
quest.race-floe.name: The Floe Line Race
quest.race-floe.race.title: Race up The Floe Line
quest.race-floe.race.copy: Along the Floe Line to the Rime Gate and back, captain. Sigrun says the ice won't move for us. Good. Neither will I.
quest.race-floe.race.start: Eleven winters that ice sat there. It can watch you race. On the horn.
quest.race-stormbreak.name: The Stormbreak Crossing
quest.race-stormbreak.race.title: Race across The Stormbreak
quest.race-stormbreak.race.copy: From Fogwatch, across the Stormbreak and round Broch Isle, captain. Elias says wait for the quiet breath. I say take whatever wind you get.
quest.race-stormbreak.race.start: Listen for the horn, captain. Then go.
quest.race-four-winds.name: The Four Winds Cup
quest.race-four-winds.race.title: Sail for the Four Winds Cup
quest.race-four-winds.race.copy: Four seas, one race: out of Saltmere, a mark off each sea's gateway, and home to your own pier on Skerry. The Four Winds Cup, captain. I've wanted to sail it for years.
quest.race-four-winds.race.start: Four seas, one course, one book. On the horn, captain.
regatta.result.gold.title: Gold medal
regatta.result.gold.line1: Gold, and all I saw was your wake. Well sailed, captain!
regatta.result.gold.line2: Gold! You had that wind on a string, captain.
regatta.result.silver.title: Silver medal
regatta.result.silver.line1: Silver, and ahead of Kestrel! She won't speak to me now.
regatta.result.silver.line2: Silver, and you beat me fair. Next time, captain.
regatta.result.bronze.title: Bronze medal
regatta.result.bronze.line1: Bronze! Kestrel had you this time, but only just.
regatta.result.bronze.line2: Bronze, captain. One tack less and that's silver.
regatta.result.none.title: Course sailed
regatta.result.none.line1: Course sailed and everyone home. That's a race, captain. Again?
regatta.result.none.line2: No medal this time. The marks will wait, captain. Go again whenever you like.
quest.standing-wren.name: Wren’s standing order
quest.standing-wren.ask-1.title: Bring timber to Saltmere
quest.standing-wren.ask-1.copy: Kestrel cracked a batten showing off. Timber, captain? Don't tell Ines.
quest.standing-wren.ask-1.thanks: Batten's in, and she's quicker than ever. Bad news for you!
quest.standing-wren.ask-2.title: Bring grain to Saltmere
quest.standing-wren.ask-2.copy: Racing's hungry work. Grain for the crew's porridge, captain?
quest.standing-wren.ask-2.thanks: Porridge and a fair wind. That's a racing breakfast. Thanks!
quest.standing-wren.ask-3.title: Bring stone to Saltmere
quest.standing-wren.ask-3.copy: Rook wants a proper stone at the start line. He says a ledger needs a mark. Stone, captain?
quest.standing-wren.ask-3.thanks: The start stone's set. Rook dusted it. Twice.
regatta.newBest: A new best, captain! Rook’s writing it in the book.
regatta.won.regatta-ring: Three races, three wins. The Saltmere pennant is yours, captain. Fly it high, so I know where to find you.
regatta.won.regatta-seas: Four seas, four wins! The Far Seas pennant, captain. Nobody’s flown it before you.
regatta.won.regatta-cup: The Four Winds Cup, captain, and its pennant. I’ll win it back, mind. One day.
regatta.cupSet: The Four Winds Cup stands on your pier, captain.
regatta.cupBook: Four Winds Cup: the Fair Winds Trading Company, captain at the helm. Entered in good order.
regatta.hornToast: The horn! Over the line, captain.
regatta.retired: Race left. Sail it again from the Quay whenever you like.
regatta.leaveText: Docking here ends the race. You can sail it again from the Quay whenever you like.
quest.race-mill.name: The Mill Run
quest.race-mill.race.title: Race round the mill point
quest.race-mill.race.copy: Maren says the flour's no use to anyone until it's across the water. So we race it. Out round the mill point and home, captain. Mind the lee under the hill.
quest.race-mill.race.start: Sails full of flour dust, I'm told. On the horn.
quest.race-mill.race.done: Maren's baking you a loaf, win or not. Don't tell her I said so.
quest.race-light.name: The Stonehaven Light Race
quest.race-light.race.title: Race round the Stonehaven light
quest.race-light.race.copy: Ness will watch from the tower and call it. Round Teeth Rock, keep the light to port, and home to the quay. He's been timing me for years, captain. Time someone else.
quest.race-light.race.start: The light's lit, the water's clear. No excuses. On the horn.
quest.race-light.race.done: Ness wrote it down twice, to be sure. He's like that.
quest.race-abbey.name: The Abbey Bell
quest.race-abbey.race.title: Race to Abbey Head and back
quest.race-abbey.race.copy: Out to Abbey Head, round Bell Rock and back to Saltmere. A long reach, a long reach home, and not a tack to hide behind, captain. Rook says the bell rings for a clean run. I've never heard it.
quest.race-abbey.race.start: Straight lines are the hardest to sail. On the horn.
quest.race-abbey.race.done: Rook says he heard something. Rook says a lot of things.
quest.race-coral-squall.name: The Coral Squall
quest.race-coral-squall.race.title: Race round Lone Palm
quest.race-coral-squall.race.copy: Juno swears there's a shower that crosses the Coral Line about now. Round Lone Palm and back to Sunreach, captain. Go round the rain or through it. I'll be taking the dry way.
quest.race-coral-squall.race.start: A warm squall and a warm welcome, captain. On the horn.
quest.race-coral-squall.race.done: Juno has the kettle on. Rain makes everyone thirsty.
quest.race-snowberry-squall.name: The Snowberry Squall
quest.race-snowberry-squall.race.title: Race round Snowberry Isle
quest.race-snowberry-squall.race.copy: Nell says a flurry comes down off the pack ice and sweeps the cove at the turn. Round Snowberry Isle and home to Rimewick, captain. Sail round it, or sail fast through it.
quest.race-snowberry-squall.race.start: Cold hands, warm hearts, quick boats. On the horn.
quest.race-snowberry-squall.race.done: Nell has hot jam on bread for the winner. And for you.
quest.race-sandwick-squall.name: The Sandwick Scramble
quest.race-sandwick-squall.race.title: Race round Sandwick Holm
quest.race-sandwick-squall.race.copy: Pip says there's a squall that comes over Sandwick like it has an appointment. Round the holm and back to Fogwatch, captain. Pip's bet on you. I've bet on me.
quest.race-sandwick-squall.race.start: Hold your hat, Pip's holding the stakes. On the horn.
quest.race-sandwick-squall.race.done: Pip says whoever lost owes amber. Nobody has amber. Good race.
regatta.won.regatta-club: Eight races, eight wins. The club pennant is yours, captain. You're a member for life, and I'll thank you not to wear it at Rook's table.
regatta.gift.regatta-club: I've nothing left to give but this. She's Tern, my own design, built light and built to fly. There's room for a loaf and a letter, and not much more. Look after her, captain.
club.board.title: Club board
club.board.intro: Your times, pinned up by Wren and kept in Rook's book.
club.board.empty: Nothing pinned yet. Enter a race and your first time goes up here.
quest.race-meridian.name: The Meridian Run
quest.race-meridian.race.title: Race from Sunreach to Rimewick
quest.race-meridian.race.copy: Warm water at one end, ice at the other, and all the sea between, captain. Juno will see you off with tea. Sigrun will have jam waiting. Don't stop for either.
quest.race-meridian.race.start: One long line on the chart, captain. On the horn.
quest.race-meridian.race.done: Kestrel's crew will bring your boat home. Go and find that jam.
quest.race-great-reach.name: The Great Reach
quest.race-great-reach.race.title: Race from Emberhold to Fogwatch
quest.race-great-reach.race.copy: Black rocks at one end, fog and amber at the other, captain, and the wind behind you most of the way. Bram says glass shows the truth. Let's see what a long reach shows.
quest.race-great-reach.race.start: West to east and don't look back. On the horn.
quest.race-great-reach.race.done: Elias will have the kettle on and a question about your sails. Kestrel's crew will fetch your boat.
